name: Nelsons Farm Market
description: Nelsons Farm Market is a working farm in 11108 Gordon Avenue, MI. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer, autumn, and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
